value.rationale: Time-reversal of stationary scalar measurements can be invisible to ordinary two-time autocovariances. Here a natural ordered cubic statistic distinguishes forward from backward dynamics, with an explicit all-lag rational law, a geometrically motivated dimension-dependent first-winding cutoff and a surprising universal signed total -2/9 for every dimension.
